s3-check-if-the-array-is-sorted.trick: The sheet asks whether the array is nondecreasing. The linked LeetCode variant also allows one rotation, so both checks are shown.

s3-find-missing-number-in-an-array.trick: For the linked LeetCode task, XOR 0 through n with the array of n values; paired values cancel. A separate helper covers the 1-through-n lesson variant.

s3-find-the-number-that-appears-once-and.trick: XOR cancels each paired value, leaving the unpaired value.

s3-kadane-s-algorithm-maximum-subarray-s.trick: Extend the running sum while it helps; the moment it goes negative it can only drag future sums down, so reset to 0. Track the best sum seen at any point — even a single (negative) element counts.

s3-largest-element-in-an-array.trick: Keep the largest value seen while scanning once.

s3-left-rotate-an-array-by-d-places.trick: Three reversals rotate left by d in place. The linked LeetCode task rotates right, so a right-rotation helper is also included.

s3-left-rotate-an-array-by-one-place.trick: Save the first element, shift left, and append it. The linked LeetCode page rotates right; a one-place right variant is included too.

s3-maximum-consecutive-ones.trick: Grow the current run for a one; reset it at a zero, tracking the maximum.

s3-move-zeros-to-end.trick: Copy nonzero values forward in their original order, then fill the suffix with zeros.

s3-remove-duplicates-from-sorted-array.trick: Write each value that differs from the last kept value into the next free prefix position.

s3-second-largest-element-in-an-array-wi.trick: Track the largest and the strictly smaller runner-up. Use a found flag so INT_MIN remains a valid answer.

s3-linear-search.trick: Scan left to right and return the first matching index; if none matches, return -1.

s3-find-the-union.trick: Merge the two sorted arrays with two pointers, adding a value only if it differs from the last output.

s3-longest-subarray-with-given-sum-k-pos.trick: For nonnegative values, expand the right end and shrink the left end while the sum exceeds k.

s3-longest-subarray-with-sum-k-positives.trick: Store the earliest index of each prefix sum; a previous prefix of current-k gives a sum-k subarray.

s3-2sum-problem.trick: Before storing the current value, look up target-value among earlier values.

s3-sort-an-array-of-0-s-1-s-and-2-s.trick: Dutch national flag: [0,low) are zeros, [low,mid) ones, and (high,n) twos.

s3-majority-element-n-2-times.trick: Boyer-Moore cancels different values in pairs. The linked task guarantees a majority, so the survivor is the answer.

s3-print-subarray-with-maximum-subarray-.trick: Kadane's algorithm tracks the best sum and its endpoints. The linked GFG page asks a different adjacent-pair problem.

s3-stock-buy-and-sell.trick: Track the cheapest earlier price; selling today earns price-minimumSoFar.

s3-rearrange-the-array-in-alternating-po.trick: Place positives at even indices and negatives at odd indices to preserve order; append surplus values.

s3-next-permutation.trick: Find the rightmost ascent, swap its smaller element with the next larger suffix value, then reverse the suffix.

s3-leaders-in-an-array-problem.trick: Scan from right to left; a value is a leader if it is at least as large as every value to its right.

s3-longest-consecutive-sequence-in-an-ar.trick: Start counting only at numbers whose predecessor is absent, then walk each consecutive run once.

s3-set-matrix-zeros.trick: Use the first row and column as markers, remembering separately whether the first column originally had a zero.

s3-rotate-matrix-by-90-degrees.trick: For a square matrix, transpose across the diagonal, then reverse every row.

s3-print-the-matrix-in-spiral-manner.trick: Maintain top, bottom, left, and right boundaries; traverse one edge, then shrink its boundary.

s3-count-subarrays-with-given-sum.trick: For each prefix sum, add the number of earlier prefixes equal to current-k.

s3-pascal-s-triangle.trick: Each inner cell is the sum of the two cells directly above it; edge cells are one.

s3-majority-element-n-3-times.trick: At most two values can occur more than n/3 times. Cancel triples of distinct values, then verify candidates.

s3-3-sum-problem.trick: Sort; fix one value, then sweep the remaining range with two pointers, skipping duplicates.

s3-4-sum-problem.trick: Sort, fix two values, then use two pointers for the remaining pair; skip duplicates at every level.

s3-largest-subarray-with-0-sum.trick: Equal prefix sums bound a zero-sum subarray; keep each prefix's earliest index for maximum length.

s3-count-number-of-subarrays-with-given-.trick: Count earlier prefix XORs equal to currentPrefix XOR k. The linked GFG page asks for subsets, not subarrays.

s3-merge-overlapping-subintervals.trick: Sort intervals by start; extend the last merged interval while the next one overlaps.

s3-merge-two-sorted-arrays-without-extra.trick: For two full arrays, the shrinking-gap method merges without an extra array. The linked LeetCode task has spare slots in its first array; fill those backward instead.
s3-merge-two-sorted-arrays-without-extra.time: O((n+m) log(n+m)) gap method; O(n+m) linked LeetCode variant

s3-find-the-repeating-and-missing-number.trick: Use each value as an index and negate the value there; an already-negative slot reveals the duplicate. The positive slot reveals the missing value.

s3-count-inversions.trick: During merge sort, if left[i] exceeds right[j], it exceeds every remaining left value too.

s3-reverse-pairs.trick: Before merging sorted halves, advance a right pointer for each left value while left > 2*right.

s3-maximum-product-subarray.trick: Track both maximum and minimum products ending here: a negative value can swap their roles.
